original_test_intent: Perform an explicitly scoped BMC factory reset on a dedicated target and prove documented defaults, reconnectability and authorized recovery.
original_method: Preserve Master command and source evidence; apply corrections only in this Review record.
manual_activity: System owner approves destructive scope, backup, downtime, credential/network recovery and acceptance matrix.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct command family is insufficient without exact destructive scope and recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture immutable inventory/configuration, confirm target twice, issue one approved reset, wait boundedly, reconnect independently, validate every documented default and restore approved configuration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original source and timing retained; no missing byte or value is assumed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture immutable inventory/configuration, confirm target twice, issue one approved reset, wait boundedly, reconnect independently, validate every documented default and restore approved configuration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target binding, semantic acceptance and safety without altering Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A BMC reboot or successful reconnect alone does not satisfy factory-default coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Can erase management identity, network, accounts, certificates, policies and audit state.

project_override_considerations: Approved alternate tooling is allowed only with equivalent functional evidence and explicit original-method coverage disclosure.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master omits interface/scope semantics, accepts command success and clears logs before an intentionally destructive reset.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose is identifiable and remaining items are supplyable execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines a recoverable destructive lifecycle and a real default-state oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: Factory reset intentionally invalidates current management state. Completion before the reset says nothing about the resulting defaults; acceptance depends on independent recovery and field-by-field comparison to the vendor/project default contract.
